events.title: NEW DEMO!
events.summary: Hello everyone,We are back! It’s only been a little over a month since we resumed work on Ants in Space, but we couldn’t wait to share what we’ve been up to. So, we put together a fresh demo update for you.In this build you’ll get to explore one planetary system and try out the new features. Expect a nice visual overhaul, a batch of new features and a round of balance tweaks.Major HighlightsQueen Upgrades: Added random upgrades to Ant Queen upon leveling up.Termites Update: Added a Termite Timer

Regarding the Content Update - you have to wait, but won't have to wait long. Changelog: Balance: Increased the number of termites in the prologue. Adjusted Champion discovery difficulty by reducing some numbers. Visual: Refined the visual representation of resources in uncovered but non-visible areas. events.title: For the first time, you can try out Ants in Space!
events.summary: After 2 years of development we are happy to share first playable version for everyone! We hope you'll enjoy it! Don't hesistate to get the demo from our page store, leave feedback and stuff! https://store.steampowered.com/app/2366290/Ants_in_Space/

events.title: Strategy Fest Live Streaming Session
events.summary: We are streaming Live playing in celebration of Strategy Fest!

events.title: See Ants Gameplay For the First Time!
events.summary: We are happy to be a part of Steam Strategy Fest 2023! 😄 Unfortunately, we couldn't meet the deadline to prepare the demo for you to play during the Strategy Fest. However, we still want to showcase the gameplay for you. Join us and seize the opportunity to engage with the developers during the live stream. Our session will commence simultaneously with the start of the fest, at 17:00 UTC. See you there!

events.title: Join The Playtest, Get The Free Copy

You have the option to play the game offline and provide feedback, BUT you can also join our discord and choose to play live with screen sharing, allowing us to learn directly from your experience!
